description:
-= Bedchamber =-
You're now in a bedchamber.

You can make out an opened dresser right there by you. The dresser contains a chocolate bar and a book.

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going north. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unguarded.
objective: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to take the chocolate bar from the dresser inside the bedchamber. After taking the chocolate bar, eat the chocolate bar. And once you've done that, you win!
